earnings.title: Teva’s Pivot to Growth Strategy Delivers 33% Growth Across Key Innovative Brands; Raises
highlights: EPS was $0.86; cash flow generated from operating activities was $241 million and free cash flow was approximately $0.5 billion.
Q3 2026 revenues of $4.4 billion , a decrease of 2% year-over-year in both U.S. dollars
AUSTEDO global revenues were $751 million, increasing 21% year-over-year in local currency.
AJOVY global revenues were $269 million, increasing 61% year-over-year in local currency.
UZEDY revenues were $85 million, increasing 96% year-over-year in local currency.
outlook: Teva is raising its 2026 revenue outlook to $2.55 billion–$2.65 billion, from $2.45 billion–$2.60 billion.
Teva is raising its 2026 revenue outlook to $930 million–$960 million, from $850 million–$870 million.
Teva currently expects more than $0.8 billion in biosimilars revenues in 2026,
$700 million of net savings, by 2027 including ~two-thirds expected to be realized in 2026.
